title.zh: Ideogram 4.5专攻AI修图「越改越坏」，权重也将开放
title.en: Ideogram 4.5专攻AI修图「越改越坏」，权重也将开放

current_state.zh: Ideogram launched Ideogram 4.5, an image editing model that limits iterative edits to specified regions while preserving the rest of the image, offering Precise Edit and Generate+Edit API modes with tiered pricing from $0.008 to $0.22 per image and a forthcoming open-weights release.
current_state.en: Ideogram launched Ideogram 4.5, an image editing model that limits iterative edits to specified regions while preserving the rest of the image, offering Precise Edit and Generate+Edit API modes with tiered pricing from $0.008 to $0.22 per image and a forthcoming open-weights release.
